The below is not accurate. An artificial neural network is deterministic, not arbitrary. It generates the same output to the same input every time. Because it’s math.

What makes AI models arbitrary is that AI companies stick in random number generators. That’s not consciousness. https://t.co/NKVrNWvR6a

quoted.text:
No. A concatenation of many matrix multiplications is… just a single matrix multiplication (that’s what linearity means).

Rather, a neural network is a concatenation of matrix multiplications *and* nonlinearities, i.e. a concatenation of arbitrary linear and nonlinear operations, i.e. an arbitrary operation.

So the relevant question is rather: can consciousness be instantiated by an arbitrary abstract operation?
I’d say it’s pretty clear which way round the burden of proof goes.

text:
Happy World Teachers' Day! 

Today, I want to recognize the educators who have dedicated their careers to opening doors for our children and supporting the next generation of leaders. 

For years, I fought to reform the Windfall Elimination Provision (WEP), an unfair provision that devastated Social Security benefits for almost 90,000 retired public servants—teachers included—here in Massachusetts. 

Teachers and public servants should never be penalized for playing by the rules. That is why I was proud to help champion the Social Security Fairness Act in January 2025, which repealed WEP and the Government Pension Offset. As a result, this change restored Social Security benefits for millions of public servants, including teachers, and brought peace of mind to MA residents. 

On World Teachers’ Day, I’m proud to stand with our teachers. Thank you all for everything you do, not just today but every day.

Our region was built by working people, and I'll keep pushing for the job training and investment it takes to bring manufacturing jobs back to our communities.

https://t.co/NYQ9CURG7o

NJDEP says the Aeroflex hangar in Andover, NJ, is too unsafe for a woman-owned flight school (that trains military pilots) and mechanics, so they're planning to kick them out this Christmas. What's even crazier: the repairs would cost half the amount ($4M). Their plans to demolish it — $8M. Taxpayers should be pissed. Let's save these jobs and keep the airport open! Even Harrison Ford learned to fly there.

Happy to meet the NJDEP Commissioner in Andover to review the building and small businesses together.
@NewJerseyDEP, rescind the evictions.

urls.description: Christina Rivera kept her health insurance this year because she needed major back surgery. But maintaining coverage meant absorbing a monthly premium that rose from $235 in 2025 to $1,336 in 2026 — with a higher deductible. “That’s just not reasonable for anybody who is relying on the ACA for healthcare,” said Riviera, a Charlottesville-area resident and founder of the nonprofit Called to Justice. “I don’t have that sitting around. It’s not in the cushions of the couch.” Small nonprofits often depend on the Affordable Care Act marketplace because reasonably priced group coverage is out of reach, Rivera said. After enhanced federal premium tax credits expired last December, her insurance bill became another financial burden alongside groceries, gasoline and utilities.
urls.title: Virginia Democrats warn more healthcare strains loom after November election • Virginia Mercury

For Nevadans facing high housing costs today, this research raises an important question: how does access to stable, affordable housing shape family decisions? My housing platform focuses on expanding housing supply, creating more pathways to homeownership, and giving working families more opportunities to build generational wealth. Every Nevadan deserves the opportunity to plan for their future with confidence.

I’m especially grateful for the incredible teachers across Western New York, including my mother and my sister, and I join communities around the world in recognizing their dedication and the difference they make every day.

Happy World Teachers’ Day to educators everywhere!

The videos circulating online of white supremacists rallying in Danbury are horrifying. I am in close communication with local leaders and will continue to assist in any way I can.

text:
Today, I joined @laredopalominos to break ground on the new Veterans Center of Excellence, a project I helped make possible by securing $1.4 million in federal Community Project Funding.

This investment will transform the historic Guardhouse at the Fort McIntosh Campus into a one-stop center where veterans and their families can access academic and career counseling, tutoring, financial aid assistance, mental health services, job placement support, and veteran peer mentoring. 

For veterans transitioning from military service into the classroom or workforce, having these resources in one place can make a real difference. It also gives this historic building a new purpose while preserving an important part of Laredo College’s military history.

Our veterans served our country, and we have a responsibility to make sure they have the resources and opportunities they have earned when they return home. I look forward to coming back to Laredo College when we cut the ribbon and open the doors to this new center.

For 25 years, the Regional Water Authority has brought together water providers and affiliates across the greater Sacramento region to strengthen the reliability, quality, and affordability of our water supply for the 2.2 million people they serve.

Their work has helped residents use water more efficiently and supported major investments in groundwater storage to strengthen our region’s long-term water resilience.

I was honored to join the RWA’s 25th anniversary celebration in Sacramento to present Executive Director Jim Peifer with a Congressional Record statement recognizing this important milestone.

Congratulations to the Regional Water Authority on 25 years of regional leadership and service to our community!

text:
Today at his rally, the President of the United States said this about Iran. "Let them take out Los Angeles or San Diego. This is a very small price to pay."

No American city is a small price to pay. 

No American life is.

Whatever he meant, a Commander in Chief should never talk this way about the people he swore to protect. 

Our servicemembers sacrifice everything for us, and he just told the world their hometowns are expendable.

Protecting Americans should unite all of us. Every Republican who represents Southern California should say so tonight. https://t.co/LqmWqxoI5H
